description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling lead conversion, form validation, UI toggling, setting return values, adding related data, and map location search within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: verifyConvertLeadData
methods.description: Validates lead conversion form data, ensuring required fields are filled and correct before submission.

methods.name: togglePotFields
methods.description: Enables or disables potential-related form fields based on checkbox state.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Sets product ID and name in the parent window for lead or product selection.

methods.name: set_return_todo
methods.description: Sets product ID and name in the parent window for to-do item creation.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets lead name and ID in the opener window for specific lead selection.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist
methods.description: Updates email relations for a lead in the system.

methods.name: submitform
methods.description: Submits a mass delete form with the specified entity ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation
methods.description: Opens Google Maps with the address details for location search.

methods.name: selectTransferTo
methods.description: Displays transfer options for Accounts or Contacts based on user selection.
